new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import SQLeanite.SQLite.JsonExtract
+
+namespace SQLeanite.SQLite.JsonArrow
+open JsonValid
+
+def abbreviated (value : Value) (path : Array UInt8) : Array UInt8 :=
+  if byte path 0 == 36 then path
+  else if (match value with | .integer _ => true | _ => false) then
+    "$[".toUTF8.data ++ (if byte path 0 == 45 then #[35] else #[]) ++ path ++ #[93]
+  else if path.all (fun c => digit c.toNat || alpha c.toNat || c == 95) then
+    "$.".toUTF8.data ++ path
+  else if byte path 0 == 91 && path.size ≥ 3 && byte path (path.size-1) == 93 then
+    #[36] ++ path
+  else "$.\"".toUTF8.data ++ path ++ #[34]
+
+def evaluate (value pathValue : Value) : Except String Value := do
+  let encoded ← JsonBinary.evaluate value
+  let .blob input := encoded | return .null
+  if Text.isNull pathValue then return .null
+  let path := JsonExtract.nulPrefix (Text.bytes pathValue)
+  let expanded := abbreviated pathValue path
+  let selected := JsonAccess.select input (some (Text.fromBytes expanded))
+  let pos ← match selected with
+    | .ok pos => pure pos
+    | .error message => throw (if message == JsonAccess.pathError expanded then JsonAccess.pathError path else message)
+  let some pos := pos | return .null
+  let value ← JsonExtract.valueAt input pos
+  match value with
+  | .blob bytes =>
+      let rendered ← JsonPretty.render bytes #[] (4*bytes.size+4) false 0 0 0
+      return Text.fromBytes (rendered.chunks.foldl (fun out chunk => out ++ chunk) #[])
+  | _ => return value
+
+
+theorem evaluate_null (path : Value) : evaluate .null path = .ok .null := rfl
+
+theorem abbreviated_root (value : Value) (path : Array UInt8)
+    (root : byte path 0 = 36) : abbreviated value path = path := by
+  simp [abbreviated, root]
+
+theorem abbreviated_zero : abbreviated (.integer 0) #[48] = #[36,91,48,93] := rfl
+
+theorem evaluate_null_path (value : Value) (input : Array UInt8)
+    (loaded : JsonBinary.evaluate value = .ok (.blob input)) :
+    evaluate value .null = .ok .null := by
+  simp only [evaluate, loaded, Text.isNull] <;> rfl
+
+end SQLeanite.SQLite.JsonArrow

+/-- A malformed U+2028/U+2029 escape prefix consumes its remaining byte span,
+as jsonUnescapeOneChar does when jsonBytesToBypass finds no continuation. -/
+theorem unescape_invalid_separator (input : Array UInt8) (finish fuel pos : Nat)
+    (long : pos+1 < finish) (marker : byte input (pos+1) = 226)
+    (invalid : continuationEnd input finish (input.size+1) pos = pos) :
+    unescape input finish (fuel+1) pos = (629145, finish) := by
+  simp [unescape, marker, invalid, Nat.not_le_of_gt long]

+private def expectSQLiteJsonArrow : IO Unit := do
+  for (expression, expected) in (sqliteJsonArrowCases0 ++ sqliteJsonArrowCases250 ++ sqliteJsonArrowCases500 ++ sqliteJsonArrowCases750 ++ sqliteJsonArrowCases1000 ++ sqliteJsonArrowCases1250 ++ sqliteJsonArrowCases1500 ++ sqliteJsonArrowCases1750 ++ sqliteJsonArrowCases2000 ++ sqliteJsonArrowCases2250) do
+    let sql := "SELECT typeof(" ++ expression ++ "),hex(" ++ expression ++ "),hex(quote(" ++ expression ++ "));"
+    match CoreSQL.execute Core.State.empty sql with
+    | .error message => unless expected == "error:" ++ SQLite.Text.hexBytes (SQLite.Diagnostic.bytes message) do
+        fail s!"JSON ->> error differs: {sql}: {message}"
+    | .ok (_, results) =>
+        let values ← (expected.splitOn "|").mapM fun field => match SQLSurface.value (.text field) with
+          | .ok value => pure value | .error message => fail message
+        unless results.getLast?.map (·.rows) == some [values] do
+          fail s!"JSON ->> value differs: {sql}"
+
+private def expectSQLiteQuotedFunctionLimits : IO Unit := do
+  for name in ["\"->>\"", "[->>]", "`->>`", "\"char\"", "[char]", "`char`", "\"a\"\"b\"", "`a``b`", "\"CoAlEsCe\""] do
+    let call := name ++ "(" ++ String.intercalate "," (List.replicate 1001 "1") ++ ")"
+    let scripts := ["SELECT " ++ call ++ ";",
+      "SELECT CASE WHEN 0 THEN " ++ call ++ " ELSE 1 END;",
+      "CREATE TABLE t(a,b); UPDATE t SET a=" ++ call ++ " WHERE 0;",
+      "CREATE TABLE t(a,b); UPDATE t SET a=((" ++ call ++ ")) WHERE 0;",
+      "CREATE TABLE t(a,b); UPDATE t SET (a,b)=(1," ++ call ++ ") WHERE 0;"]
+    for sql in scripts do
+      match CoreSQL.execute Core.State.empty sql with
+      | .error message => unless message == "too many arguments on function " ++ name do
+          fail s!"quoted function limit spelling differs: {message}"
+      | .ok _ => fail "quoted function limit accepted excessive arguments"
+

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compare raw bytes (including after NUL), quoted values and public JSON ->> SQL values, BLOB bytes, paths and diagnostics.
+
+Fresh seeded JSON, C JSONB and unfiltered byte mutations mix with fixed numeric,
+escape, nesting and header controls. Each root, path and chained-path request is
+executed independently. Full status/output/first diagnostic must match C; files
+must stay unchanged and retain identical typed rows and C integrity. Large
+observations are compacted only after exact comparison, never for acceptance.
+"""
+import argparse,concurrent.futures,hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,random,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('position_corpus',ROOT/'scripts/run-json-position-differential.py');helpers=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(helpers)
+literal=helpers.literal;blob=helpers.blob;node=helpers.node;mutate=helpers.mutate;random_value=helpers.random_value
+
+def main():
+ p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--seed',type=int,default=355051);p.add_argument('--fixtures',type=int,default=2);p.add_argument('--random-cases',type=int,default=16);p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args();rng=random.Random(a.seed)
+ sqlite=os.environ.get('SQLITE3_BIN','sqlite3');binary=ROOT/'.lake/build/bin/sqleanite';source=helpers.digest();exe=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+ def run(cmd,sql):
+  r=subprocess.run(cmd,input=sql.encode(),capture_output=True,timeout=180);return dict(code=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout.decode('latin1'),stderr=r.stderr.decode('latin1'))
+ def csql(path,sql):return run([sqlite,'-batch','-bail',str(path)],sql)
+ def snapshot(path):return {s:hashlib.sha256(Path(str(path)+s).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for s in ['','-wal'] if Path(str(path)+s).exists()}
+ def compact(result):
+  out=dict(result)
+  if len(out['stdout'])>8192:
+   data=out.pop('stdout').encode('latin1');out.update(stdout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),stdout_bytes=len(data),stdout_prefix=data[:512].decode('latin1'))
+  return out
+ paths=[literal(x) for x in ['a','v','a.b','a\\nb','é','','[0]','[#-1]','$','$.a','$.v[0]','$[0]','$[1]','$[#-1]','$[0].x','$."a.b"','$."a\\nb"','bad','$..a','$[foo]','$[999]',b'\xff',b'$\0bad']]+['NULL','0','-1','-9223372036854775808','1.0','1.25',"X'242e61'"]
+ fixed=[]
+ for s in ['null','{}','[]','1','1.0','-0.0','9223372036854775808','0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF','-0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF','0x10000000000000000','NaN','Inf','-.1','1.e2','','invalid','[','{a:1,}',"{'x':'\\xFF'}",'"\\uD800"','"\\uD800\\uDC00"','"a\\u0000b"','"a\x01b"','1\0tail','{"a":1,"a":2,"v":[2,{"x":3}]}','{"a.b":1,"a\\nb":2}']:
+  for expression in [literal(s),blob(s.encode())]:fixed.append(dict(group='fixed-text-storage',expression=expression))
+ for expression in ['NULL','0','-9223372036854775808','9223372036854775807','1.25','1e999','-1e999',"X'00'","X'0b'","X'c000'","X'1bff'","X'00ff'","X'f900000000000000025c00'"]:
+  fixed.append(dict(group='fixed-storage',expression=expression))
+ for kind in range(16):
+  for payload in [b'',b'-',b'1\r2',b'0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF',b'\\uD800',b'\\q',b'\x17a\x00',b'\xff']:
+   fixed.append(dict(group='fixed-binary-node',expression=blob(node(kind,payload))))
+ for size in [11,12,255,256,65535,65536]:fixed.append(dict(group='fixed-header-size',expression=literal(json.dumps('x'*size))))
+ for depth in [998,999,1000,1001]:
+  value=b'\x00'
+  for _ in range(depth):value=node(11,value)
+  for expression in [literal('['*depth+'0'+']'*depth),blob(value)]:fixed.append(dict(group='fixed-depth',expression=expression))
+ queries=[]
+ def query(group,sql):queries.append(dict(group=group,sql=sql))
+ for fn in ['"->>"']:
+  for args in ['', '*',"'bad'",'1,2,3','DISTINCT 1',"NULL,'bad'","'bad',NULL","'{}','bad',NULL","'{}',NULL,'bad'","DISTINCT '{}','$','$'"]:
+   for expr in [fn+'('+args+')','0 AND '+fn+'('+args+')','CASE WHEN 0 THEN '+fn+'('+args+') ELSE 1 END']:
+    for tail in ['', ' FROM t LIMIT 0']:query('fixed-call-shape','SELECT '+expr+tail+';')
+ for count in [1000,1001]:query('fixed-argument-limit',"SELECT typeof(\"->>\"('1',"+','.join(["'$'"]*(count-1))+'));')
+ for sql in ["SELECT '[10,20]' ->> 0 + 1;", "SELECT '[10,20]' ->> (0 + 1);", "SELECT '[10,20]' ->> 1 || 'x';", "SELECT '[10,20]' ->> (1 || 'x');", "SELECT '[10,20]' ->> 0 = 10;", "SELECT '[10,20]' ->> 0 IN (10,20);", "SELECT 0 AND (missing ->> '$');", "SELECT 0 AND ((missing ->> '$') COLLATE BINARY);", "SELECT CASE WHEN 0 THEN (missing ->> '$') ELSE 1 END;", 'SELECT NULL ->> abs(-9223372036854775808);', 'SELECT (abs(-9223372036854775808)) ->> NULL;', "SELECT 'bad' ->> NULL;", "SELECT NULL ->> 'bad';", "SELECT '{a:{b:3}}' ->> 'a' ->> 'b';", "SELECT '{a:[4,5]}' ->> 'a' ->> -1;", "SELECT '1' ->> '$' COLLATE NOCASE;", "SELECT id FROM t WHERE v ->> '$' ORDER BY id;", "SELECT id,hex(v ->> '$') FROM t ORDER BY id DESC;", "SELECT count(*),hex(min(v ->> '$')),hex(max(v ->> '$')) FROM t;", "SELECT hex(v ->> '$'),count(*) FROM t GROUP BY v ->> '$' ORDER BY 1;", "SELECT id,hex(v ->> '$') AS b FROM t WHERE id<10 ORDER BY b,id LIMIT 4;", "SELECT t.id,hex(t.v ->> '$') FROM t JOIN u ON t.id=u.id ORDER BY t.id;"]:query('fixed-query-shape',sql)
+ for name in ['"->>"', '[->>]', '`->>`', '"char"', '[char]', '`char`', '"a""b"', '`a``b`', '"CoAlEsCe"']:
+  call=name+'('+','.join(['1']*1001)+')'
+  for expr in [call,'CASE WHEN 0 THEN '+call+' ELSE 1 END']:query('quoted-function-limit','SELECT '+expr+';')
+ def run_fixture(fixture,page,folder,base,values):
+  cases=[];runs=[]
+  for mode in ['--verified-file','--verified-wal-file']:
+   left=folder/(mode+'-lean.db');right=folder/(mode+'-c.db');shutil.copyfile(base,left);shutil.copyfile(base,right);bl,br=snapshot(left),snapshot(right)
+   for i,value in enumerate(values):
+    for call in ["(v ->> '$')",'(v ->> p)',"\"->>\"(v,p)","((v ->> '$') ->> q)"]:
+     sql=f'SELECT typeof({call}),hex({call}),hex(quote({call})) FROM t WHERE id={i};';l=run([str(binary),mode,str(left)],sql);c=csql(right,sql);cases.append(dict(fixture=fixture,page_size=page,mode=mode,input=i,group=value['group'],sql=sql,lean=compact(l),sqlite=compact(c),matched=helpers.same(l,c)))
+   for q in queries:
+    l=run([str(binary),mode,str(left)],q['sql']);c=csql(right,q['sql']);cases.append(dict(q,fixture=fixture,page_size=page,mode=mode,lean=compact(l),sqlite=compact(c),matched=helpers.same(l,c)))
+   obs='PRAGMA integrity_check;SELECT id,typeof(v),hex(v),typeof(p),hex(p),typeof(q),hex(q) FROM t ORDER BY id;';lo,co=csql(left,obs),csql(right,obs);runs.append(dict(fixture=fixture,page_size=page,mode=mode,observation_lean=compact(lo),observation_sqlite=compact(co),lean_unchanged=bl==snapshot(left),sqlite_unchanged=br==snapshot(right),matched=lo['code']==co['code']==0 and lo['stdout']==co['stdout'] and lo['stdout'].startswith('ok\n') and bl==snapshot(left) and br==snapshot(right)))
+  return cases,runs
+ cases=[];runs=[];fixtures=[]
+ with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sqleanite-json-arrow-') as tmp, concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
+  futures=[]
+  for fixture in range(a.fixtures):
+   values=list(fixed)
+   for _ in range(a.random_cases):
+    data=json.dumps(random_value(rng),ensure_ascii=bool(rng.randrange(2)),separators=(',',':')).encode();encoded=csql(':memory:','SELECT hex(jsonb('+literal(data)+'));');assert encoded['code']==0;binary_value=bytes.fromhex(encoded['stdout'].strip())
+    for expression in [literal(data),blob(binary_value),literal(mutate(rng,data)),blob(mutate(rng,binary_value)),literal(data+rng.choice([b' x',b' /*',b'\0tail',b'\xff'])),blob(rng.randbytes(rng.randrange(1,64)))]:values.append(dict(group='seeded-input',expression=expression))
+   values=[dict(v,path=rng.choice(paths),path2=rng.choice(paths)) for v in values]
+   page=512<<(fixture%8);folder=Path(tmp)/str(fixture);folder.mkdir();base=folder/'base.db'
+   setup=f'PRAGMA page_size={page};CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,v,p,q);CREATE TABLE u(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY);BEGIN;'+''.join(f'INSERT INTO t VALUES({i},'+v['expression']+','+v['path']+','+v['path2']+');' for i,v in enumerate(values))+''.join(f'INSERT INTO u VALUES({i});' for i in range(20))+'COMMIT;';made=csql(base,setup);assert made['code']==0,made;fixtures.append(dict(fixture=fixture,page_size=page,values=values))
+   futures.append(pool.submit(run_fixture,fixture,page,folder,base,values))
+  for future in futures:
+   part_cases,part_runs=future.result();cases.extend(part_cases);runs.extend(part_runs)
+ assert source==helpers.digest() and exe==hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'Implementation changed during evaluation'
+ failures=sum(not x['matched'] for x in cases+runs);report=dict(seed=a.seed,random_cases=a.random_cases,fixtures=fixtures,cases=cases,runs=runs,failures=failures,fixture_workers=2,comparison=__doc__.strip(),implementation_sha256=source,executable_sha256=exe,harness_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),helper_sha256=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'scripts/run-json-position-differential.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),sqlite_version=subprocess.check_output([sqlite,'--version'],text=True).strip());a.output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(cases=len(cases),failures=failures)));return bool(failures)
+if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compare raw bytes (including after NUL), quoted values and public JSON ->> with pinned upstream random_json/random_json5 data.
+
+Each generated JSON/JSON5 text and its C JSONB is retained, alongside an
+unfiltered byte mutation. Each input is executed separately through both public
+file modes and C, so a malformed value cannot mask another value. Full exact
+SQL storage type and quoted-value hex output, status and first diagnostic are compared. C alone loads the upstream
+generator. File snapshots and independent C integrity are checked after reads.
+"""
+import argparse,hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,random,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('json_position',ROOT/'scripts/run-json-position-differential.py')
+helpers=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(helpers)
+def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+def main():
+ p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--start-seed',type=int,required=True);p.add_argument('--count',type=int,default=1024);p.add_argument('--extension',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--generator-source',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args()
+ sqlite=os.environ.get('SQLITE3_BIN','sqlite3');binary=ROOT/'.lake/build/bin/sqleanite';source=helpers.digest();executable=sha(binary);rng=random.Random(a.start_seed)
+ def run(cmd,sql):
+  r=subprocess.run(cmd,input=sql.encode(),capture_output=True,timeout=120);return dict(code=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout.decode('latin1'),stderr=r.stderr.decode('latin1'))
+ def csql(path,sql):return run([sqlite,'-batch','-bail',str(path)],sql)
+ def snapshot(path):return {s:sha(Path(str(path)+s)) for s in ['','-wal'] if Path(str(path)+s).exists()}
+ setup=f'.load {a.extension} sqlite3_randomjson_init\nCREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,v);\n'
+ for i,expr in enumerate(['random_json(seed)','random_json5(seed)','jsonb(random_json(seed))','jsonb(random_json5(seed))']):
+  setup+=f'WITH RECURSIVE seeds(seed) AS (VALUES({a.start_seed}) UNION ALL SELECT seed+1 FROM seeds WHERE seed<{a.start_seed+a.count-1}) INSERT INTO t SELECT seed*4+{i},{expr} FROM seeds;\n'
+ setup+='SELECT id,typeof(v),hex(v) FROM t ORDER BY id;'
+ generated=csql(':memory:',setup);assert generated['code']==0,generated;inputs=[]
+ for line in generated['stdout'].splitlines():
+  index,kind,data=line.split('|');data=bytes.fromhex(data)
+  for changed,value in [(False,data),(True,helpers.mutate(rng,data))]:
+   inputs.append(dict(seed=int(index)//4,representation=int(index)%4,mutated=changed,storage=kind,input_hex=value.hex()))
+ assert len(inputs)==8*a.count
+ cases=[];runs=[]
+ with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sqleanite-jsonb-upstream-') as tmp:
+  folder=Path(tmp);base=folder/'base.db';assert csql(base,'CREATE TABLE guard(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY);')['code']==0
+  for mode in ['--verified-file','--verified-wal-file']:
+   left=folder/(mode+'-lean.db');right=folder/(mode+'-c.db');shutil.copyfile(base,left);shutil.copyfile(base,right);bl,br=snapshot(left),snapshot(right)
+   for value in inputs:
+    expr="X'"+value['input_hex']+"'"
+    if value['storage']=='text':expr='CAST('+expr+' AS TEXT)'
+    for path in ["'$'",rng.choice(["'$.a'","'a'","'[0]'","'$[#-1]'","'a.b'","'bad'",'NULL','0','-1','1.0',"X'ff00'"])]:
+     call='(('+expr+') ->> ('+path+'))';sql=f'SELECT typeof({call}),hex({call}),hex(quote({call}));'
+     l=run([str(binary),mode,str(left)],sql);c=csql(right,sql);cases.append(dict(value,path=path,mode=mode,lean=l,sqlite=c,matched=helpers.same(l,c)))
+   lo,co=csql(left,'PRAGMA integrity_check;SELECT * FROM guard;'),csql(right,'PRAGMA integrity_check;SELECT * FROM guard;')
+   runs.append(dict(mode=mode,lean_unchanged=bl==snapshot(left),sqlite_unchanged=br==snapshot(right),observation_lean=lo,observation_sqlite=co,matched=lo['code']==co['code']==0 and lo['stdout']==co['stdout']=='ok\n' and bl==snapshot(left) and br==snapshot(right)))
+ assert source==helpers.digest() and executable==sha(binary)
+ failures=sum(not c['matched'] for c in cases+runs)
+ report=dict(start_seed=a.start_seed,count=a.count,generation_sql=setup,generator_source_sha256=sha(a.generator_source),extension_sha256=sha(a.extension),cases=cases,runs=runs,failures=failures,implementation_sha256=source,executable_sha256=executable,harness_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),helper_sha256=sha(ROOT/'scripts/run-json-position-differential.py'),comparison=__doc__.strip(),sqlite_version=subprocess.check_output([sqlite,'--version'],text=True).strip())
+ a.output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(cases=len(cases),failures=failures)));return bool(failures)
+if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compare stored raw result bytes, including bytes after NUL, and persist \"->>\"() results and failures in both public Core file engines.
+
+Pinned C supplies page geometry and input JSONB/JSON text. Newly seeded data and SQL
+variants mix with fixed transaction/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/RETURNING/CTAS
+templates. Compare full stdout, normalized first-line error, post-statement
+C typed rows/catalog/integrity, Lean reopen, and a subsequent independent C
+write. Preserve unchanged files when C leaves its input unchanged. Page size
+is recorded separately because the current writer may convert it to 4096.
+"""
+import argparse,hashlib,json,os,random,re,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+def digest():
+ h=hashlib.sha256()
+ for p in sorted((ROOT/'SQLeanite').rglob('*.lean'))+[ROOT/'Main.lean']:h.update(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).encode()+b'\0'+p.read_bytes())
+ return h.hexdigest()
+def literal(s):
+ data=s.encode() if isinstance(s,str) else s
+ return "CAST(X'"+data.hex()+"' AS TEXT)"
+def main():
+ p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--seed',type=int,default=355052);p.add_argument('--fixtures',type=int,default=4);p.add_argument('--random-cases',type=int,default=16);p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args();rng=random.Random(a.seed)
+ sqlite=os.environ.get('SQLITE3_BIN','sqlite3');binary=ROOT/'.lake/build/bin/sqleanite';source=digest();exe=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+ def run(cmd,sql):
+  r=subprocess.run(cmd,input=sql.encode(),capture_output=True,timeout=120)
+  return dict(code=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout.decode('latin1'),stderr=r.stderr.decode('latin1'))
+ def csql(path,sql):return run([sqlite,'-batch','-bail',str(path)],sql)
+ def error(r):
+  if not r['code']:return ''
+  line=r['stderr'].splitlines()[0] if r['stderr'] else ''
+  return re.sub(r'^(?:Parse error|Runtime error|Error)(?: near line [0-9]+)?: ?', '',line)
+ def snapshot(path):
+  return {s:hashlib.sha256(Path(str(path)+s).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for s in ['','-wal'] if Path(str(path)+s).exists()}
+ def same(l,r):return bool(l['code'])==bool(r['code']) and l['stdout']==r['stdout'] and error(l)==error(r)
+ inputs=[literal(s) for s in ['null','1','[]','{"a":[1,true]}','{a:1}','[1,]','"\\x41"','invalid','[','01','1\0junk']]
+ inputs += ['NULL','1','1.25',"X'00'","X'0b'","X'3c176100'","X'1bff'","X'c000'","X'00ff'"]
+ inputs += [literal('"a\\u0000b"'),literal('"\\u0000tail"'),"X'3a610062'","X'37ff007a'"]
+ generated=[]
+ for _ in range(a.random_cases):
+  value={'v':[rng.randrange(-100000,100000),rng.choice([None,True,False]),''.join(rng.choice('abé中😀') for _ in range(5))]}
+  s=json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False);r=csql(':memory:','SELECT hex(jsonb('+literal(s)+'));');assert r['code']==0,r
+  generated.append(dict(text=s,jsonb_hex=r['stdout'].strip()))
+  inputs.extend([literal(s),"X'"+r['stdout'].strip()+"'"])
+ scripts=[]
+ def add(group,sql):scripts.append(dict(group=group,sql=sql))
+ expressions=["(v ->> '$')",'(v ->> flags)',"((v ->> '$') ->> 0)","(CAST(v AS TEXT) ->> '$')","(CASE WHEN flags IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE v END ->> '$')"]
+ for expr in expressions:
+  add('update',f'UPDATE t SET valid={expr};')
+  add('insert-select',f'INSERT INTO out SELECT id,{expr} FROM t;')
+  add('ctas',f'CREATE TABLE made AS SELECT id,{expr} AS valid FROM t;')
+  add('delete',f'DELETE FROM t WHERE {expr}>0;')
+  add('update-returning',f'UPDATE t SET valid={expr} WHERE id<=20 RETURNING id,valid;')
+ for suffix in ['ROLLBACK;','COMMIT;']:
+  add('transaction',"BEGIN;\nUPDATE t SET valid=\"->>\"(v,'$');\n"+suffix+'\nSELECT id,valid FROM t ORDER BY id;')
+ add('savepoint',"SAVEPOINT j;\nUPDATE t SET valid=\"->>\"(v,'$');\nROLLBACK TO j;\nRELEASE j;\nSELECT id,valid FROM t ORDER BY id;")
+ error_expr="\"->>\"(CASE WHEN id=3 THEN abs(-9223372036854775808) ELSE v END,'$')"
+ add('atomic-error','UPDATE t SET valid='+error_expr+';')
+ add('transaction-error',"BEGIN;\nUPDATE t SET valid=\"->>\"(v,'$');\nUPDATE t SET valid="+error_expr+';\nCOMMIT;')
+ add('returning-error','UPDATE t SET valid=1 WHERE id<5 RETURNING id,'+error_expr+';')
+ add('insert-returning',"INSERT INTO t VALUES(999,'[1,]',2,\"->>\"('[1,]','$')) RETURNING id,valid;")
+ add('insert-error','INSERT INTO out SELECT id,'+error_expr+' FROM t;')
+ add('ctas-error','CREATE TABLE made AS SELECT id,'+error_expr+' AS valid FROM t;')
+ add('fixed-call-arity','UPDATE t SET valid=\"->>\"();')
+ add('fixed-call-arity','INSERT INTO out SELECT id,\"->>\"(v) FROM t;')
+ add('star-call','UPDATE t SET valid=\"->>\"(*);')
+ add('argument-limit',"UPDATE t SET valid=\"->>\"('1',"+','.join(["'$'"]*1000)+') WHERE 0;')
+ for expr in expressions[:3]:
+  for where in [' WHERE id<=7',' WHERE id>21']:
+   add('successful-update',f'UPDATE t SET valid={expr}'+where+' RETURNING id,valid;')
+   add('successful-insert',f'INSERT INTO out SELECT id,{expr} FROM t'+where+';')
+   add('successful-ctas',f'CREATE TABLE made AS SELECT id,{expr} AS valid FROM t'+where+';')
+ add('successful-savepoint',"SAVEPOINT j; UPDATE t SET valid=\"->>\"(v,'$') WHERE id<=7; ROLLBACK TO j; RELEASE j; SELECT id,valid FROM t ORDER BY id;")
+ add('successful-transaction',"BEGIN; UPDATE t SET valid=\"->>\"(v,'$') WHERE id<=7; COMMIT; SELECT id,hex(valid) FROM t ORDER BY id;")
+ for _ in range(a.random_cases):
+  expr=rng.choice(['v','CAST(v AS TEXT)','NULL',error_expr,'flags']);path=rng.choice(["'$'","'$.v'",'flags','NULL']);lo=rng.randrange(len(inputs)+1);hi=lo+rng.randrange(1,10)
+  add('seeded-update',f'UPDATE t SET valid=\"->>\"({expr},{path}) WHERE id BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi};')
+ for name in ['"->>"','char','coalesce']:
+  call=name+'('+','.join(['1']*1001)+')'
+  for value in [call,'('+call+')','(('+call+'))','('+call+',2)','(2,'+call+')']:
+   names='(valid,flags)' if value.endswith(',2)') or value.startswith('(2,') else 'valid'
+   add('fixed-limit-diagnostic','UPDATE t SET '+names+'='+value+' WHERE 0;')
+ for name in ['"->>"', '[->>]', '`->>`', '"char"', '[char]', '`char`', '"a""b"', '`a``b`', '"CoAlEsCe"']:
+  call=name+'('+','.join(['1']*1001)+')'
+  for value in [call,'(('+call+'))','(1,'+call+')']:
+   columns='(valid,flags)' if value.startswith('(1,') else 'valid'
+   add('quoted-function-limit','UPDATE t SET '+columns+'='+value+' WHERE 0;')
+ observation='PRAGMA integrity_check;PRAGMA user_version;PRAGMA application_id;PRAGMA table_info(t);PRAGMA table_info(out);PRAGMA table_info(made);SELECT id,typeof(v),hex(v),typeof(flags),quote(flags),typeof(valid),hex(valid),quote(valid) FROM t ORDER BY id;SELECT id,typeof(valid),hex(valid),quote(valid) FROM out ORDER BY id;'
+ read='SELECT id,typeof(v),hex(v),typeof(flags),quote(flags),typeof(valid),hex(valid),quote(valid) FROM t ORDER BY id;SELECT id,typeof(valid),hex(valid),quote(valid) FROM out ORDER BY id;'
+ cases=[];fixtures=[]
+ with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sqleanite-json-write-') as tmp:
+  for fixture in range(a.fixtures):
+   folder=Path(tmp)/str(fixture);folder.mkdir();base=folder/'base.db';page=512<<(fixture%8)
+   setup=f'PRAGMA page_size={page};CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,v,flags,valid);CREATE TABLE out(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,valid);'
+   for i,value in enumerate(inputs):
+    flags=rng.choice(["'$'","'v'","'$.v'","'$[0]'","'$[#-1]'","'bad'",'NULL','0','-1','1.0'])
+    setup+=f'INSERT INTO t VALUES({i+1},{value},{flags},NULL);'
+   created=csql(base,setup);assert created['code']==0,created
+   fixtures.append(dict(fixture=fixture,page_size=page,setup=setup))
+   for mode in ['--verified-file','--verified-wal-file']:
+    for index,script in enumerate(scripts):
+     case_dir=folder/(mode+str(index));case_dir.mkdir();left=case_dir/'lean.db';right=case_dir/'sqlite.db';shutil.copyfile(base,left);shutil.copyfile(base,right)
+     bl,br=snapshot(left),snapshot(right)
+     l=run([str(binary),mode,str(left)],script['sql']);c=csql(right,script['sql']);al,ar=snapshot(left),snapshot(right)
+     lo,co=csql(left,observation),csql(right,observation)
+     made=csql(right,"SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name='made';")['stdout']=='1\n'
+     extra='SELECT id,typeof(valid),hex(valid),quote(valid) FROM made ORDER BY id;' if made else ''
+     lr=run([str(binary),mode,str(left)],read+extra);cr=csql(right,read+extra)
+     geometry=dict(lean=csql(left,'PRAGMA page_size;'),sqlite=csql(right,'PRAGMA page_size;'))
+     follow="INSERT INTO t VALUES(100000,'{}',1,1);SELECT id,typeof(v),hex(v),typeof(valid),hex(valid),quote(valid) FROM t ORDER BY id;PRAGMA integrity_check;"
+     lw,cw=csql(left,follow),csql(right,follow)
+     matched=same(l,c) and lo['code']==co['code']==0 and lo['stdout']==co['stdout'] and lo['stdout'].startswith('ok\n') and same(lr,cr) and lw['code']==cw['code']==0 and lw['stdout']==cw['stdout'] and (ar!=br or al==bl)
+     cases.append(dict(script,fixture=fixture,page_size=page,mode=mode,lean=l,sqlite=c,lean_error=error(l),sqlite_error=error(c),observation_lean=lo,observation_sqlite=co,reopen_lean=lr,reopen_sqlite=cr,subsequent_c_write_lean=lw,subsequent_c_write_sqlite=cw,geometry=geometry,lean_unchanged=al==bl,sqlite_unchanged=ar==br,matched=matched))
+ assert source==digest() and exe==hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'Implementation changed during evaluation'
+ failures=sum(not c['matched'] for c in cases)
+ report=dict(seed=a.seed,random_cases=a.random_cases,generated_jsonb=generated,fixtures=fixtures,cases=cases,failures=failures,comparison=__doc__.strip(),implementation_sha256=source,executable_sha256=exe,harness_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),sqlite_version=subprocess.check_output([sqlite,'--version'],text=True).strip())
+ a.output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(cases=len(cases),failures=failures)));return bool(failures)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Public fixed and seeded JSON escape-tail regression with complete raw values.
+
+Malformed E2 escapes, valid line continuations, ordinary unknown escapes and
+escaped object-key comparisons are all evaluated without outcome filtering.
+Each input independently exercises ->>, jsonb_extract, json_type,
+json_array_length, json_valid(...,8), and json_error_position. Exact output,
+status and first diagnostics are compared, and file bytes must stay unchanged.
+"""
+import argparse, concurrent.futures, hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, random, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('position_corpus', ROOT / 'scripts/run-json-position-differential.py')
+helpers = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(helpers)
+
+def inputs(rng, count):
+    out = []
+    def add(kind, payload, path, group, key=False, width=None):
+        value = helpers.node(kind, payload) if width is None else bytes([{1:12,2:13,4:14,8:15}[width]*16+kind]) + len(payload).to_bytes(width,'big') + payload
+        if key: value = helpers.node(12, value + helpers.node(11, helpers.node(3, b'41')))
+        out.append(dict(group=group, expression=helpers.blob(value), path=helpers.literal(path)))
+    payloads = [b'\\\xe2', b'\\\xe2abc', b'prefix\\\xe2\x80', b'\\\xe2\x80aTAIL', b'\\\xe2\x80\xaaTAIL',
+        b'\\\xe2\x80\xa8TAIL', b'\\\xe2\x80\xa9TAIL', b'\\\n\\\xe2suffix', b'\\\r\n\\\xe2\x80zEND',
+        b'\\\xe2\x80\xa8\\\xe2suffix', b'\\\xe2\x80\xa8\\qEND', b'\\qEND', b'\\\xe1END',
+        b'a\\u0000b\\\xe2remaining', b'\\\xe2\x00remainder', b'\\\xe2\\u0041\\nEND']
+    for kind in [7,8,9,10]:
+        for payload in payloads: add(kind,payload,b'$','fixed-escape-tail')
+    for kind in [7,8,9,10]:
+        for key, path in [(b'\\\xe2abc',b'\\\xe2xyz'), (b'pre\\\xe2abc',b'pre\\\xe2xyz'),
+            (b'\\\xe2abc',b'\\\xe2abc'), (b'\\\xe2abc',b'\\qabc'), (b'\\qabc',b'\\qxyz'),
+            (b'\\\xe2\x80\xa8tail',b'tail'), (b'\\\n\\\xe2abc',b'\\\r\\\xe2xyz'),
+            (b'a\\u0000b',b'a\\u0000c'), (b'\\\xe2abc',b'\\\xe2\x80\xa8xyz')]:
+            add(kind,key,b'$."'+path+b'"','fixed-key-escape-tail',key=True)
+    out.append(dict(group='candidate1-regression',expression="X'c82431335c745c22613232335c745c75346532645c756433645c75646530307d5ce234653264'",path="'$'"))
+    for i in range(count):
+        prefix = rng.choice([b'', b'pre', b'\\\n', b'\\\r\n', b'a\\u0000b', b'\\\xe2\x80\xa8'])
+        escape = rng.choice([b'\\\xe2',b'\\\xe2\x80',b'\\\xe2\x80\xa8',b'\\\xe2\x80\xa9',b'\\q',b'\\\xe1'])
+        tail = rng.randbytes(rng.randrange(0,30))
+        payload = prefix + escape + tail
+        kind = rng.choice([7,8,9,10]); width = rng.choice([None,1,2,4,8])
+        add(kind,payload,b'$','seeded-escape-tail',width=width)
+        keypath = prefix + escape + rng.randbytes(rng.randrange(0,30))
+        add(kind,payload,b'$."'+keypath+b'"','seeded-key-escape-tail',key=True,width=width)
+    return out
+
+def calls(value='v', path='p'):
+    return [f'({value} ->> {path})',f'jsonb_extract({value},{path})',f'json_type({value},{path})',
+        f'json_array_length({value},{path})',f'json_valid({value},8)',f'json_error_position({value})']
+
+def observe(call): return f'SELECT typeof({call}),hex({call}),hex(quote({call}));'
+
+def main():
+    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--seed',type=int,required=True);p.add_argument('--random-cases',type=int,default=64);p.add_argument('--fixtures',type=int,default=8);p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args()
+    rng=random.Random(a.seed);sqlite=os.environ.get('SQLITE3_BIN','sqlite3');binary=ROOT/'.lake/build/bin/sqleanite';source=helpers.digest();exe=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    def run(cmd,sql):
+        x=subprocess.run(cmd,input=sql.encode(),capture_output=True,timeout=180)
+        return dict(code=x.returncode,stdout=x.stdout.decode('latin1'),stderr=x.stderr.decode('latin1'))
+    def csql(path,sql):return run([sqlite,'-batch','-bail',str(path)],sql)
+    def snapshot(path):return {s:hashlib.sha256(Path(str(path)+s).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for s in ['','-wal'] if Path(str(path)+s).exists()}
+    def fixture_run(fixture,page,folder,base,values):
+        cases=[];runs=[]
+        for mode in ['--verified-file','--verified-wal-file']:
+            left=folder/(mode+'-lean.db');right=folder/(mode+'-c.db');shutil.copyfile(base,left);shutil.copyfile(base,right);bl,br=snapshot(left),snapshot(right)
+            for i,value in enumerate(values):
+                for call in calls():
+                    sql=observe(call)[:-1]+f' FROM t WHERE id={i};';l=run([str(binary),mode,str(left)],sql);c=csql(right,sql)
+                    cases.append(dict(fixture=fixture,page_size=page,mode=mode,input=i,group=value['group'],sql=sql,lean=l,sqlite=c,matched=helpers.same(l,c)))
+            sql='PRAGMA integrity_check;SELECT id,typeof(v),hex(v),typeof(p),hex(p) FROM t ORDER BY id;';l,c=csql(left,sql),csql(right,sql)
+            runs.append(dict(fixture=fixture,page_size=page,mode=mode,lean=l,sqlite=c,lean_unchanged=bl==snapshot(left),sqlite_unchanged=br==snapshot(right),matched=l['code']==c['code']==0 and l['stdout']==c['stdout'] and l['stdout'].startswith('ok\n') and bl==snapshot(left) and br==snapshot(right)))
+        return cases,runs
+    fixtures=[];cases=[];runs=[]
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sqleanite-json-escape-tail-') as tmp, concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
+        futures=[]
+        for fixture in range(a.fixtures):
+            values=inputs(rng,a.random_cases);page=512<<(fixture%8);folder=Path(tmp)/str(fixture);folder.mkdir();base=folder/'base.db'
+            setup=f'PRAGMA page_size={page};CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,v,p);BEGIN;'+''.join(f'INSERT INTO t VALUES({i},'+v['expression']+','+v['path']+');' for i,v in enumerate(values))+'COMMIT;'
+            made=csql(base,setup);assert made['code']==0,made;fixtures.append(dict(fixture=fixture,page_size=page,values=values));futures.append(pool.submit(fixture_run,fixture,page,folder,base,values))
+        for future in futures:
+            part,observations=future.result();cases.extend(part);runs.extend(observations)
+    assert source==helpers.digest() and exe==hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'Implementation changed during evaluation'
+    failures=sum(not x['matched'] for x in cases+runs)
+    report=dict(seed=a.seed,random_cases=a.random_cases,fixtures=fixtures,cases=cases,runs=runs,failures=failures,fixture_workers=2,comparison=__doc__.strip(),implementation_sha256=source,executable_sha256=exe,harness_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),helper_sha256=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'scripts/run-json-position-differential.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),sqlite_version=subprocess.check_output([sqlite,'--version'],text=True).strip())
+    a.output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(cases=len(cases),failures=failures)));return bool(failures)
+if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
